name: Astrophysics and Cosmology
definition: Papers concerning celestial objects, the structure of the universe, gravitational phenomena, and space science.

name: High Energy Physics
definition: Papers on particle physics, nuclear physics, quantum field theory, string theory, and fundamental forces.

name: Condensed Matter Physics
definition: Papers on the physical properties of solid and liquid matter, including superconductivity, magnetism, and materials science.

name: Atomic, Molecular, Optical and Quantum Physics
definition: Papers on atomic interactions, optics, photonics, quantum information science, and quantum mechanics.

name: Fluid Dynamics and Plasma Physics
definition: Papers on the behavior of fluids, plasmas, turbulence, and transport phenomena.

name: Mathematics
definition: Papers on pure and applied mathematics, including algebra, geometry, analysis, topology, and mathematical physics.

name: Computer Science
definition: Papers on computing theory, artificial intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, and information systems.

name: Engineering
definition: Papers on the design and construction of systems, including electrical, mechanical, control, and telecommunications engineering.

name: Statistics and Probability
definition: Papers on statistical methods, probability theory, stochastic processes, and data analysis models.

name: Biological and Medical Sciences
definition: Papers on biology, bioinformatics, neuroscience, medicine, and healthcare.

name: Earth and Environmental Sciences
definition: Papers on geology, hydrology, climatology, environmental processes, and planetary science.

name: Social Sciences and Humanities
definition: Papers on economics, political science, sociology, philosophy, and arts.
